name: fxcarry_top2_3mo_monthly
hypothesis: Hold the 2 G10 currencies with the highest short-rate differential vs USD (3mo-smoothed), rebalanced monthly. Classic FX carry: high-rate currencies earn the rate differential.

name: fxcarry_top3_3mo_monthly
hypothesis: Broader carry basket (top 3 of 6) to dilute single-currency risk while still tilting to high-carry.

name: fxcarry_top2_1mo_monthly
hypothesis: Less smoothing (1mo) to test whether reacting faster to rate moves helps or just adds turnover/noise.

name: fxcarry_top2_6mo_quarterly
hypothesis: Slow carry: 6mo-smoothed signal, quarterly rebalance, to minimise turnover and trade only on persistent rate differentials.

name: fxcarry_top1_3mo_monthly
hypothesis: Concentrated: hold only the single highest-carry currency. Maximal carry exposure, maximal single-currency risk.
